summary: Container growth topology runs all components (gateway, controller, hub, EDA, database) on one tested VM: 16 GB RAM (32 GB for bundled installs with hub_seed_collections=true, which takes 45+ minutes), 4 CPUs, 60 GB disk (15 GB install dir, /var/tmp 1 GB online or 3 GB offline, 10 GB temp for bundled), 3000 IOPS.
questions: What are the VM requirements for the container growth topology?
How much RAM does a containerized growth install need with hub_seed_collections?
How much disk space does containerized AAP growth topology need?

answer_card.title: Container growth topology VM
answer_card.answer_md:
| Requirement | Minimum |
|---|---|
| RAM | 16 GB (32 GB for bundled installs with `hub_seed_collections=true`) |
| CPUs | 4 |
| Disk | 60 GB total; install dir 15 GB; `/var/tmp` 1 GB online / 3 GB offline; temp dir 10 GB for offline/bundled |
| IOPS | 3000 |

One VM hosts all components: `automationgateway`, `automationcontroller`, `automationhub`, `automationeda`, `database`.
